Common Questions

What does the percentage apply to?

The fee is a percentage of the linehaul rate on each load we book for you. Fuel surcharge is not included. The dollar examples above show what that looks like on a $2,500 linehaul rate.

Is there a contract?

No. If you are not satisfied with our service, there is no obligation to continue.

Which trailer types do you dispatch?

Dry van, flatbed, reefer and car hauler.

What happens after I apply?

We will reach out by phone or email to go over your equipment, lanes and goals. It helps to have your MC authority, insurance certificate and W-9 ready.

Do you work with fleets?

Yes. For 3 or more trucks, get in touch and we will put together fleet pricing.

About Us

At Iron Wing Dispatching, we specialize in providing personalized dispatch services tailored to the unique needs of owner-operators and small motor carriers. Our mission is to maximize your profitability by finding the best loads, negotiating with brokers, and handling the logistics—so you can focus on driving.

What sets us apart is firsthand experience. Our founder spent years behind the wheel as an owner-operator, hauling freight over countless miles. He knows the long hours, the tight delivery windows, the frustration of deadhead miles and the constant balance between running legal hours and chasing better-paying freight. We use that insight to find loads that fit your trailer and schedule, smooth out communication with brokers, and keep your compliance paperwork current, so you are never stranded without options.
